description: The exact strings the catalogue uses for types, supertypes, subtypes and rarities. Call this before filtering on a rarity or a type rather than guessing the wording — "Rare Rainbow" and "Rainbow Rare" are not the same string, and only one of them matches. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.
